voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: In the early hours of April first, two thousand six, a medical student named Brian Shaffer was out with friends at a bar in Columbus, Ohio.
At one fifteen a.m., security cameras recorded him riding an escalator up to the bar's entrance.
Around one fifty-five, a camera caught him outside the bar, talking with two women. Then he moved out of frame.
No camera ever recorded him leaving.
He was twenty-seven. Twenty years later, he has never been found.
